review: The pressing sounds gorgeous — warm and quiet, no surface noise. Loved finding it hand-numbered and signed on the back. Shipped fast and packed flat with corner protectors. Already eyeing the clear vinyl version too.

This hoodie is so much nicer than typical band merch. Heavy fleece, real embroidery, and the tour dates on the sleeve are a great touch. Runs true to size. You can tell Jessica cares about the details.

Bought this as a gift for my brother who saw the quartet live. Jessica added a handwritten note and signed it to him by name. He was thrilled. The vinyl itself is beautifully pressed. Five stars all the way.
The double LP set is a treasure. The live disc captures the room perfectly. Both records are dead quiet and the gatefold photos are wonderful. Worth every penny for a fan of Kansas City jazz.

Lovely hoodie and the embroidery is top notch. Shipping took a little longer than estimated but Jessica messaged me with an update and a tracking number. Would have been five stars if the timeline matched. Will order again.

The clear vinyl looks stunning held up to the light and sounds just as good as it looks. Each label is hand-applied and mine came perfectly centered. Fast shipping and careful packaging. A real collector's piece.

The signed tour poster is even better in person. The letterpress texture is beautiful and the whole quartet signed it. Arrived rolled in a sturdy tube with no creases. It is framed and hanging in my office now.
